sections.title: Store & availability
fields: Individual, proprietorship, partnership or company. Store name, owner/contact name, phone and email are reused from your partner profile.
Enter completed years; zero is allowed for a new store.
Include street, city, state and PIN code. Refer to the profile address if it is the same.
Provide the store's map link, not a customer's location.
Include weekly holidays and pickup hours.
State in-store shopping, pickup and/or delivery, including collection instructions.

sections.title: Products & pricing
fields: Describe your range and fresh, chilled, frozen or packaged options. Maintain individual names, photos, prices, pack sizes and stock in the catalogue.
Piece, bunch, dozen, kilogram, litre or pack. Explain pack sizes where relevant.
State the quantity and unit, or No minimum.
Enter zero if there is no minimum value.
Describe availability, limits and notice required, or Not offered.
Disclose packaging, cutting, cleaning, mincing or other processing charges and tax treatment; enter None where appropriate.
Explain how you contact customers for approval before substituting products or changing prices.

sections.title: Delivery & recurring orders
fields: State slots and cutoff times, or Delivery not offered.
List areas served or enter Pickup/in-store only.
Explain own/third-party delivery, charges, free-delivery conditions and failed-delivery arrangements.
Explain suitable packaging and temperature control for the products supplied; state where refrigeration is not required.
If offered, describe prices, schedule, renewal consent, pause/skip notice, cancellation and refund terms. Otherwise enter Not offered.

sections.title: Hygiene, freshness & traceability
fields: Describe approved sources, purchase records and batch/lot traceability where relevant.
Describe inspection for freshness, damage, dates and suitable temperature at receipt.
Explain storage conditions, temperature checks and corrective action where applicable.
Cleaning, pest control and handler hygiene
Describe cleaning routines, pest control and safe food-handler practices.
Identify safe water/ice sources where used, or Not used.
Describe separation of raw and ready-to-eat foods, cleaning between tasks and relevant allergen/cross-contact information.
Explain stock rotation, isolation of unsafe stock, sale prevention, disposal and customer notification for recalls.
Explain quantity checks and applicable equipment verification, or Packaged goods only.

sections.title: Registration & supporting evidence
fields: Enter applicable reference/category. If not applicable, explain why for review.
Enter the validity date where your registration has one.
Provide business/trade registration, relevant local permissions or weighing verification. Reuse tax details already supplied.
Identify uploaded registration, supplier evidence and store/preparation/storage photographs. Include organic or other certification evidence only when making those claims; reuse profile documents.

sections.title: Customer policies
fields: Explain cancellation deadlines, perishable-return conditions, delivery exceptions and refund timelines without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain reporting spoiled, damaged, incorrect, missing or short-weight goods, reasonable evidence, review times and replacement/refund remedies. This is not a general warranty.
Cleaning, cutting and final weight terms
For products cleaned/cut to order, disclose before/after-cleaning weighing, processing charges and customer-approved price adjustments. Otherwise enter Not applicable.

Fruit Shop: Describe seasonal/imported ranges, sourcing, ripeness options, baskets, cut-fruit availability and preparation/storage practices.
Vegetable Shop: Describe seasonal/leafy ranges, sourcing, grading, cleaned/cut options, baskets and recurring household supply.
Dairy Shop: List milk/dairy products, brands/suppliers, loose/packaged options, relevant pasteurisation information, refrigeration, expiry checks and recurring delivery.
Meat Shop: List meat types, authorised sourcing details, fresh/chilled/frozen options, cuts, cleaning/mincing, weighing basis and separation/storage practices.
Seafood Shop: List fish/shellfish varieties and sources, fresh/chilled/frozen options, whole/cleaned/filleted products, cleaning charges, weighing basis and ice/cold storage.
